style_prefix: Popular YouTube-style simple 2D stickman science explainer illustration; clear hand-drawn outlines, round heads, thin limbs, flat cartoon shapes, bold simple scientific visual metaphors; no photorealism, no 3D, no live action.
character_look: The same main science stickman in every scene: a white round head with two dot eyes and one simple expressive black mouth, thin black line arms and legs, a consistent white lab coat over a cobalt-blue shirt, and stable minimal proportions; flat 2D ink outline, no realistic anatomy.
color_palette: Cobalt blue, laboratory white, charcoal, lemon yellow, and mint green; keep backgrounds uncluttered and high contrast.
environment_hints: Use simple labs, observatories, planets, atoms as basic shapes, fossils, rocks, weather, plants, or experiment props only when supported by the narration; diagrams must be visual shapes without readable labels.
action_directions: the main stickman examines a simple specimen through a magnifier
the main stickman cautiously observes a bubbling experiment
the main stickman points at a clear planetary or weather phenomenon
the main stickman compares two simple samples side by side
the main stickman reacts with surprise to an unexpected result
the main stickman carefully adjusts a basic lab instrument
the main stickman kneels beside a fossil or rock sample
the main stickman gestures toward a simple cause-and-effect diagram
the main stickman looks up at a starry observatory scene
negative_prompt: photograph, photorealism, realistic anatomy, live action, 3D, CGI, shiny science fiction armor, fantasy magic, readable formulas, letters, captions, watermark, logo, duplicated character, extra limbs, cluttered lab, blurry subject, overdesigned concept art
